subject: PO approval: split payrun, net terms request, and discount clawback
messages:
--- Message 1 of 4 ---
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@medframe.com>
To: michael_grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 09:12:03 -0700
Subject: PO MF-98765 — invoice cadence, net terms, and discount ask

Hi Michael,

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement is ready to issue PO MF-98765 (attached) but we need to confirm a few commercial and invoicing items before legal signs: 

- PO header and invoice MUST include the PO number (MedFrame requires exact PO on every invoice).
- We need the ability to split billing across milestone deliverables: we prefer 3 invoices (initial setup, monthly usage, final acceptance) or weekly split runs for usage-heavy months. Please confirm you can support split invoice lines tied to the PO.
- Net terms request: MedFrame standard is Net45 for new vendors. Can Redwood accept Net45?
- Discount ask: we are requesting a conditional 7% volume discount applied to invoices if invoices are paid within 30 days of receipt. If payment falls outside the window, MedFrame reserves the right to claw back the discount on the reconciliation on a quarterly basis.

I attached the draft PO (MedFrame_PO_98765.pdf). If those items are acceptable we can push to legal and get signatures. Appreciate a quick confirmation today so we can keep the procurement cycle on pace.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Senior Procurement Manager
MedFrame Health

--- Message 2 of 4 ---
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@medframe.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 10:05:27 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO MF-98765 — invoice cadence, net terms, and discount ask

Hi Elena — thanks, received the PO. Short answers below and looping in ops and pricing: Vanessa, Grace, Kar — need guidance on the discount/clawback language and whether we can accept weekly split runs as described.

- PO on invoice: yes, we will include the exact PO number on every invoice (standard billing).
- Split invoices: we can support up to 3 invoice lanes per PO (setup, recurring usage, final) and are able to accommodate weekly usage runs for specific billing periods if the ERP mapping is provided.
- Net terms: we generally price for Net30, but we can accept Net45 on enterprise POs for one-off deals.

Vanessa — can you confirm if the 7% conditional discount is feasible or if we should propose an alternative structure (tiered discount or prepay credit)? Also Grace — operationally, what do we need from MedFrame ERP to ensure weekly splits map to the PO?

I can fast-track a revised SOW and a PO template.

Best,
Mike Grant
Director, Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference

--- Message 3 of 4 ---
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Elena Morales <elena.morales@medframe.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 11:30:44 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO MF-98765 — invoice cadence, net terms, and discount ask

Hi Elena — appreciate the clear ask and the PO. We ran this by pricing and ops and propose the following compromise that keeps the deal moving while protecting Redwood's unit economics: 

1) Net terms: Redwood accepts Net45 for this PO (MF-98765) on the condition that MedFrame signs the attached SOW amendment and provides ERP remittance/mapping details within 5 business days.

2) Invoice cadence / split invoices: We will support up to three invoice lanes tied to the PO: 
   - Invoice 1: Onboarding & setup (one-time)
   - Invoice 2: Monthly usage (recurring) — can be configured as weekly runs inside Redwood, but invoiced monthly unless MedFrame requests weekly invoice delivery (additional billing overhead).
   - Invoice 3: Final acceptance/milestone (if applicable)

   If MedFrame requires weekly invoices delivered to AP, we can accommodate for an operations fee to cover the weekly processing and reconciliation overheads.

3) Discount and clawback: We cannot take an unconditional 7% discount at list price. Instead we can offer a conditional 5% early-pay discount that is applied to invoices paid within 30 days. The discount is reconciled quarterly: if invoices fall outside the payment window, Redwood will reverse (claw back) the discount on the next reconciliation run. We will include simple language in the SOW amendment to make the mechanics clear.

4) Attachments / next steps: Attached are the draft SOW (SOW_redwood_v1.docx) and a PO template (redwood_po_template.xlsx) showing the invoicing lanes and required PO fields. Please review and indicate whether MedFrame prefers weekly delivery or a monthly invoice with weekly internal runs.

If that works, we will produce a redlined SOW and DocuSign envelope for signature today.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Enterprise Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOW_redwood_v1.docx (draft), redwood_po_template.xlsx

--- Message 4 of 4 ---
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@medframe.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 15:02:12 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO MF-98765 — invoice cadence, net terms, and discount ask

Hi Vanessa / Mike — that compromise is acceptable to MedFrame. A few clarifying points before we sign: 

- We will accept a 5% early-pay discount rather than 7% as proposed, and agree to the quarterly reconciliation/clawback mechanism. Please include explicit language about the reconciliation timeline and illustrative example in the SOW amendment.
- MedFrame will take monthly invoices (Invoice 2) but requests that Redwood deliver the weekly usage CSVs for AP reconciliation. No need for weekly invoice deliveries at this time.
- I will have our ERP team provide the PO-to-invoice mapping (GL codes + cost center) and remittance contact by Wednesday COB.

Once the SOW amendment with the reconciliation clause is in DocuSign, we will route for signatures and return the signed PO. Please send the DocuSign link and updated SOW.

Attaching signed PO stub for reference: MedFrame_PO_98765.pdf (attached).

Best,
Elena Morales
Senior Procurement Manager
MedFrame Health
